findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so it does not enforce encryption for objects uploaded to it. This includes the managed vendor-roster object stored in the bucket.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration; its private ACL does not ensure that ledger export data is encrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not encrypt stored model artifacts.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration; private ACLs and versioning do not provide encryption at rest for runbook contents.
